extDesc.message: Quickly access WeRead with multi-account management and QR-code-free login.

autoLoginDesc.message: Automatically restore login state when opening WeRead, no QR scan needed

privacy1.message: All account data (Cookies, LocalStorage) is stored only in this browser's extension sandbox (chrome.storage.local) and never uploaded to any server.

privacy2.message: Only WeRead login-related cookie fields (whitelist) are kept, encrypted with AES-GCM before storage.

privacy3.message: The encryption key also lives inside the extension sandbox; other extensions cannot access this extension's storage.

privacy4.message: You can delete any or all account data at any time in Account Management; changes take effect immediately.

privacy5.message: Known limitation: the key and ciphertext share the same storage, so other native processes on this machine could theoretically read both. For higher security, a future version may derive keys from a user unlock password.
